verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a self-hosted deployment of the current Daytona sandbox platform; every doc item describes the managed service. The GitHub note says only that the old repository 'remains public and free to use, fork, and build on… as is and without support or warranty'. A community report says Daytona has gone closed source, so a frozen, unsupported public repo is not a documented self-hosting capability for the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
